root_cause.text: The bond_option_xmit_hash_policy_set() function lacks a guard to reject changing xmit_hash_policy to vlan+srcmac when a native XDP program is already loaded on a bond in 802.3ad or balance-xor mode, allowing an incompatible state that later triggers a WARN_ON during bond destruction.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "bond_option_xmit_hash_policy_set() has no such guard" and that the fix "reject[s] xmit_hash_policy changes to vlan+srcmac when an XDP program is loaded on a bond in 802.3ad or balance-xor mode." The patch adds the check `if (bond->xdp_prog && !__bond_xdp_check(BOND_MODE(bond), newval->value))` in bond_option_xmit_hash_policy_set() before updating the policy.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The bond_option_xmit_hash_policy_set() function lacks a guard to reject changing xmit_hash_policy to vlan+srcmac when a native XDP program is already loaded on a bond in 802.3ad or balance-xor mode, allowing an incompatible state that later triggers a WARN_ON during bond destruction.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The commit message states "bond_option_xmit_hash_policy_set() has no such guard" and that the fix "reject[s] xmit_hash_policy changes to vlan+srcmac when an XDP program is loaded on a bond in 802.3ad or balance-xor mode." The patch adds the check `if (bond->xdp_prog && !__bond_xdp_check(BOND_MODE(bond), newval->value))` in bond_option_xmit_hash_policy_set() before updating the policy.

candidates.rationale: Directly sets the xmit hash policy without checking if a native XDP program is already loaded in incompatible modes (802.3ad or balance-xor with vlan+srcmac), allowing an invalid state that later triggers a WARN_ON during bond destruction.
Function entry point for setting xmit hash policy; missing guard logic in its implementation is the root cause of the vulnerability.
Parameter carrying the new policy value; the function fails to validate this value against current XDP state.
Debug print that executes before the assignment; no validation is performed before logging, indicating missing guard.
Part of the debug print; directly uses the new value without checking preconditions.
Existing guard in bond_xdp_check that correctly prevents XDP when policy is vlan+srcmac; the set function lacks an equivalent check, making this guard insufficient at the policy-change time.
Function intended to validate XDP compatibility; its logic is bypassed by the set function, which does not call it before assigning the new policy.
Declaration of the check function; the existence of this function highlights that a guard is possible but not used in the set path.

vuln_statements.explanation: Function signature that begins the setter for xmit hash policy. The missing guard against changing to vlan+srcmac when a native XDP program is loaded allows an invalid state.
Parameter carrying the new policy value. The function fails to validate this value against the current XDP state, enabling the incompatible policy to be set.
Debug print that executes before any validation, indicating that no precondition check is performed before the policy is logged and applied.
Continuation of debug print directly using the new value without checking if it is safe given the current bond XDP state.

The assignment that sets the new xmit hash policy without checking if a native XDP program is already loaded in modes (802.3ad or balance-xor) that would become incompatible with vlan+srcmac policy, leading to a later WARN_ON on bond destruction.
